description: Open the sample house project in DreamPlan Home Design Software. Navigate to the exterior view and change the material of the exterior ground-floor walls from the default siding to a 'Brick' material. Once the brick texture is applied and visible on the exterior walls, take a screenshot of the 3D view and save it to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\exterior_brick_result.png'. Ensure the brick pattern is clearly visible in the saved image.
